# tensquads UI component index

- [Example](packages/ui/src/react/Example/Example.md): This is a placeholder component. Task 009 removes it when Button is added.
- [Squadmate](packages/ui/src/react/Squadmate/Squadmate.md): Import `Squadmate` from `@tensquads/ui/react`. It renders a decorative agent image with a screen reader name. It accepts an `agent` slug, an `AgentState`, a square pixel `size`, and a `locale` for the accessible name. The image is not interactive and is not in the tab order. Roster and drawing APIs are in `@tensquads/ui/squadmates`.
